Title: TFGTRS-4567 - Donna navy dress only offers the sizes the colour has (06-20)
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Product Donna dress 10018090351 on Phase Eight.
Steps:
1. Open dev.phase-eight.com/product/donna-sleeveless-maxi-dress-10018090351.html with the Navy colour selected.
2. Check the list of sizes.
Expected: Only sizes 06 to 20 are offered. Sizes 22, 24 and 26 are not displayed.

Title: TFGTRS-4567 - Black and Red colours offer their own sizes (06-26)
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. On the same product select the Black colour and check the sizes.
2. Select the Red colour and check the sizes.

Title: TFGTRS-4567 - Selecting a size does not switch the product to another colour
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. For each colour (Navy, Black, Red) select an available size.
2. Check the product name, the colour label and the main image.
Expected: The product, colour and images stay the same after selecting a size. The dress does not change to the black version.

Title: TFGTRS-4567 - Changing colour updates the list of sizes
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. Select Navy and note the sizes.
2. Select Black and then Red and note the sizes each time.
Expected: The size list matches the selected colour every time.

Title: TFGTRS-4567 - Other multi-colour products only offer the sizes of the selected colour
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. Open another Phase Eight product with several colours (for example Catherine Cream Jacket).
2. Switch colours and compare the sizes of each one.
Expected: Each colour offers only its own sizes and selecting a size does not change the colour.

Title: TFGTRS-4567 - Add to bag with a size of the selected colour
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. On the Donna dress select Navy and an available size.
2. Add the product to the bag and open the bag.
Expected: The bag shows the Navy colour and the selected size.
